title: AndyK1970Essentials
body:
# AndyK1970 Essentials

**A minimal, no-bloat essentials mod for Fabric servers.**

Homes. Warps. Flight. Invulnerability. Nothing you don't need, nothing you didn't ask for.

---

## Features

### Home
Set a personal home point and teleport back to it any time — works across dimensions.

### Warps
Ops can create named server-wide warp points. Any player can use them.

### Flight
Ops can toggle flight for themselves or grant it to any player on the server.

### Invulnerability
Ops can toggle invulnerability for themselves or any player.

> **Design philosophy:** Flight and invulnerability are tools to be used sparingly. Both are intentionally reset on server restart and player logout — a gentle nudge to keep survival feeling like survival.

---

## Commands

| Command | Who can use | What it does |
|---------|-------------|--------------|
| `/sethome` | Everyone | Sets your home to your current position |
| `/home` | Everyone | Teleports you to your home |
| `/setwarp <name>` | Ops | Creates a named warp at your current position |
| `/delwarp <name>` | Ops | Deletes a named warp |
| `/warp <name>` | Everyone | Teleports you to a named warp |
| `/warps` | Everyone | Lists all available warps |
| `/fly` | Ops | Toggles flight for yourself |
| `/fly <player>` | Ops | Toggles flight for another player |
| `/invulnerable` | Ops | Toggles invulnerability for yourself |
| `/invulnerable <player>` | Ops | Toggles invulnerability for another player |

---

## Server-Side

For multiplayer, **only the server needs this mod installed** — your players don't need anything on their end.

It also works in single-player if you install it on your client.

---

## Requirements

We try to keep up with game drops, so

### Version 1.1.0
- Minecraft 26.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
- Fabric API 0.153.0+26.2+

### Version 1.0.1
- Minecraft 26.1.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.2+
- Fabric API 0.147.0+26.1.2+
